data.readme: 1. 修复了已配置 4 个宏时，将宏配置到 LT / RT 键会异常输出原始键值的问题。
data.readme_en: 1. Fixed an issue where macros assigned to the LT / RT buttons would also output the original LT / RT inputs when 4 macros were configured.

data.readme:
1. 修复 D 模式蓝牙连接时摇杆偶尔出现异常的问题。
2. 修复摇杆与扳机操作无法重置自动关机计时的问题。
data.readme_en:
1. Fixed an issue where the joystick could behave abnormally when connected via Bluetooth in D mode.
2. Fixed an issue where joystick and trigger inputs could not reset the auto power-off timer.
